s01472_0.summary: Four heist crew members descend the salt mine in the elevator cage.
The cage stops; Raff kills the lamps and confirms the route to the vault.
Raff leaves grumbling Kite with the cage and the others step out.

s01980.summary: The technician repairs a panel while the drone needles her about shaking.
She lays out the crisis: failing heat, venting reactor, captain in the airlock.
She accidentally names the drone Winnow after her father's, and introduces herself.
Winnow offers to reroute heat at the cost of all three years of cargo.
Paloma chooses the captain over the cargo; Winnow agrees.
Meltwater floods as she races to the airlock and the light turns green.

s01537.summary: The crew works on the watch case's alarm as Odette sets the pace.
Theo frets about the guard, but every clock shows a different time.
The alarm disarms and Gus tenderly bags the jewelled watch.
A guard's flashlight sweeps the room as they hide behind the case.
The guard passes and Odette signals them out into the night.

s02315.summary: Vivienne enters the rooftop bar and sits beside a bloodstained stranger.
The stranger reveals the barman was paid to forget him.
Quentin says he knows what her husband did on Tuesday.
He stops her reaching for her purse; Dominic admits working both sides.
Quentin slides over a photo of her husband dead at the stairs.
Vivienne thanks him, finishes her whisky and leaves a big tip.

s02269.summary: Exhausted soldiers rest in the ruined cathedral; Brandt decides they stay tonight.
Osei jokes about the roofless church and teases Mikhail for sleeping standing.
Mikhail shares blankets and they spread them beside the angel.
The radio is dead; Brandt says they're on their own.
Brandt asks if he'd believe home by Christmas; his honest no pleases her.
Mikhail murmurs his mother's name; Osei covers him with a blanket.
Under the first star Osei says the fallen angel is resting.

s02430.summary: Nila counts her dogs at the frozen checkpoint as the vet examines Biscuit.
Vance says lead dog Biscuit is hurt and shouldn't lead tonight.
Nila cradles Biscuit's face and asks if she's tired.
The marshal reports closing weather and that she's forty minutes behind.
Nila asks what Vance would do; she says scratch and speaks for Biscuit.
Nila inspects the sled and asks for a substitute lead; Pepper is promoted.
With Vance's nod Nila radios she's rolling and they share parting words.
Nila departs into the dark as Vance comforts the left-behind Biscuit.

s02211.summary: Crash survivors share water in the wing's shade; Rigo refuses his share.
Rigo insists they stay with the plane because rescuers will come.
The woman calls the pilot a liar; he says it's the truth as he knows it.
The girl shares her name, Tess; the others follow with theirs.
Imani asks how far the road is; Rigo says far enough.

s01848_1.summary: The sheriff steps slowly into the saloon toward a man at the bar.
Pike and Crane trade terse words about the man she seeks.
She spots the bound barkeep; Crane refuses to untie him.
Crane reveals her brother waits in back, wanting to talk before the hanging.
Both draw and hold, guns leveled, neither firing.
Jonah tells her to put it down; she lowers it as he descends shackled.

s01275.summary: After the lost final, Delphine and Ruben dissect Greta's missed seven-ten.
Greta laments twelve years without a win.
Greta asks for no kindness and admits she's considering quitting.
Ruben and Delphine urge her to stay; she's the best Delphine has coached.
Delphine says nobody wins the seven-ten; it feels like surviving.
Ruben buys nachos and Greta commits to trying next season.
They tease Ruben about his knotted laces and finally laugh.

s00220.summary: Foreman Odalys announces the hull failed inspection at seam forty-two.
Odalys demands who signed off on the bad weld.
Kirin admits he did the pass; Branimir tries to cover for him.
No film to X-ray, which Odalys failed to order; Branimir blames her.
Hollis invokes the contract; Odalys says the ship won't sail Friday.
Odalys explains the crack would open at sea and slams the table.
Branimir proposes they cut it out tonight; Odalys makes fresh tea.

s02370.summary: In the flooded pump house Bello tries to raise Control on the radio.
Bello reveals the push is called off; they head back to the road.
The Captain radios to hold the pump house; Bello agrees.
Li Wei laughs and breaks; Bello tells him they're done and to drink.
Bello and Wrona watch the terraces; she won't let him say it's quiet.

s00715.summary: Hazel minds Mags as Ewan keeps watch with a shotgun.
Deputy Cutter radios that the bridge is out until morning.
Ewan asks about something in the corn; a scraping comes from outside.
Mags says it's the sound from when they took her mom.
They douse the light and hide as something taps along the window.

s01498.summary: At the rainy reception, guests notice a soaked stranger at the door.
The stranger crosses to Gwenda and says she won't remember him.
He recalls proposing here years ago; Gwenda recognizes him as Daniel.

s00362.summary: Halvard's family ice-fishes in a shack on the frozen lake.
Annika gives a shivering stranger tea and Bjorn seats him by the stove.
Old Margit mutters the ice is thinning; Annika urges listening.
The lake groans and Halvard orders everyone out now.

s00278.summary: Evelyn picks her way through the abandoned planetarium with a flashlight.
A creak; she finds a smiling man seated in the third row.
He says he didn't come in and that he looks after the stars.
He stands and his shadow stays still; he asks her to look up.
The projector wakes; he names himself astronomer of 1931 and the stars descend.

s00349.summary: Noelle and Delphine restore the piano in strained silence as Leo watches.
Leo recalls his late wife playing the piano every morning.
Noelle reveals his wife wanted middle C re-voiced; Delphine knew.
Delphine explains she played it out of tune for his sake; Leo bends.
The women reconcile with a nod and tune the note together.

s01005.summary: Mrs. Crabtree opens a séance while the Captain scoffs.
They join hands and she calls the spirits; nothing answers.
She summons her husband; the Captain calls him a bore.
Taps sound, the cold drops and the table lifts.
A wheezing voice calls Hortensia and Phoebe screams.
The Captain's prank is exposed: his boot and his wheeze.
Mrs. Crabtree banishes the Captain from her home.

s02181.summary: Ilsa welds a coolant line in the submersible's maintenance bay.
The hatch turns and dripping stowaway Kestrel enters.
Ilsa questions the stranger as they size each other up.
Kestrel implies the captain is dead.
Ilsa lunges for the radio; they fight and he pins her.
The main coolant feed bursts; Ilsa demands release to fix it.
He lets go and they weld the line together, shaken and close.

s02093.summary: At 3 a.m., Leandra arrives early and Dobrynin polishes shoes.
Leandra asks about his past; he prefers people going somewhere slowly.
She mentions her father; Dobrynin remembers him and his generosity.
She asks what to say to someone angry; he offers shoes and a lane.
Leandra picks size seven and coaxes him to bowl one frame.
He jokes her father was worse and they walk to Lane Twelve.

s01315.summary: Masked Contessa Isabella stands apart at the ball, watching everyone.
Poet Giovanni approaches and they trade guarded pleasantries.
He notes her absent husband and describes a poem about her.
Count Alvise in a raven mask cuts through the crowd, home early.
Alvise belittles the poet and drinks his wife's wine.
Alvise toasts fidelity publicly; Isabella toasts the masks.

s02491.summary: Darius arrives at his mother's tackle shop and they banter.
Darius notes she looks tired; she offers tea.
Darius reveals he knows she's closing the shop.
He pulls the hidden medical folder from the register; the doctor called him.
Eunice admits she meant to tell him at Easter and cries.
Darius asks her to live with him; she agrees, bringing cat and rods.

s00020.summary: Ignatius pours tea for relief keeper Tamsin on a quiet night.
Ignatius sees water running uphill and asks if she came alone.
Wet footsteps climb, the horn blares, and they slam the hatch.

s00906.summary: Lucy arrives late to the abandoned drive-in where Tariq waits.
She sits beside him in silence; he waits for her to explain.
Lucy recalls coming here with her dad, who left the next fall.
Tariq shares his earbuds and a slow song as she trembles.
Tariq claims to see the horse; Lucy laughs into tears and thanks him.

s02087.summary: Marguerite tests a flat note in her quiet workshop.
She plays a message of nine seconds of silent breath, twice.
She returns to the piano and nearly tunes the note.
Replaying it, her grip tightens and the lever clangs on the frame.
She unplugs the machine and plays one perfectly tuned chord.

s02172.summary: Renata announces two cash bags are missing from the haul.
Calloway disputes the count; Junior says someone took them.
Calloway tackles Junior into the Buick until Wren pulls them apart.
Headlights sweep the ramp and the crew freezes until they pass.
A bag drops at Tomasz's feet and everyone stares at him.
The crew scatters and the Buick leaves Tomasz alone.
